description: Free: makes a new token for a zone or hostname; the old one stops working at once. Use it when a token may have leaked (tokens pass through model context). Authorize with the current token or, for an object in your account, with nip98. The new token is shown once. Called without nip98 it returns signature_required: the exact URL, method and body to sign, the body's sha256 and an unsigned kind 27235 event template (with proof of work for accounts without a paid order). Sign that, then call again with the same arguments plus nip98. Each signed event works once, within 60 s. Secrets that are ours to receive: object tokens, account API keys (jdk_), signed NIP-98 events; never a private key (nsec or 64 hex characters), wallet connection string or seed words. A raw hex key or seed words inside a sentence cannot be caught here.

nip98.description: The signed NIP-98 event (base64 of its JSON) for exactly the request the signature_required answer of the same call named. Sign it with your own Nostr signer (local key, NIP-46 bunker or a signer tool); never send the private key itself, in any form (nsec, hex or seed words).

token.description: The current token; or give nip98 (the owning account).

name: token_rotate
title: Replace a management token (free, token or signature)
